name: Southern African Large Telescope
description: A 9.2 m optical telescope near Sutherland in the Karoo at 1,798 m, designed mainly for spectroscopy, with 91 hexagonal mirror segments. It is operated by the South African Astronomical Observatory.
highlights: First light was on 1 September 2005; President Thabo Mbeki inaugurated it on 10 November 2005.
It is described as the largest optical telescope in the Southern Hemisphere.
It is used to study black holes, supernovae, binary stars and compact stars.
